content_sections.heading: KRCL Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. CO/P/E-RE/08/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download KRCL notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Retired officer of Civil Engineering department in HAG/SAG of Indian Railways/IR PSUs; should have worked in HAG/SAG before retirement and have adequate experience in open-line as well as execution of big projects in construction. Experience: Should have worked in HAG/SAG before retirement from Indian Railway / IR PSUs and should have adequate experience in open-line as well as execution of big projects in construction. Age limit: Maximum 62 years (as on date of notification) Other conditions: Only retired employees of Indian Railways / IR PSUs may apply. Applicant must be a retired officer of the Civil Engineering department in HAG/SAG.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Re-employment basis for an initial period of 1 year. Extendable up to Three (03) years on year to year basis based on satisfactory performance. Management reserves the right to discontinue the post at any time based on requirement.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KRCL Recruitment 2026 by Email
content_sections.text: Fill the application in the prescribed format, Annexure A, complete in all respects. Clearly mention the Notification No. CO/P/E-RE/08/2026 and the post applied for. Attach scanned enclosures: self attested PPO copy, self attested grade/scale orders indicating designation, CV and 02 self attested passport size photographs. Email the application to Deputy Chief Personnel Officer/Project at [email protected] . Application must reach on or before 18/11/2026 by 17:30 hrs; late applications will not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Selection is subject to vigilance and D&AR clearance of candidate, if required.
